question: In cricket which of the following fielding positions is behind the batsman?
solution:
The correct answer is __**First slip**__.

__
 
• **The first slip is fielding position behind the batsman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cricket: **

 
 
• The first official cricket test match was played in the year **1877 **between **Australia and England in Melbourne.**
 
• The **First One Day International cricket match** was played in the year** 1971 between England and Australia in Melbourne.**
 
• The first World Cup of one-day matches was played in **1975 in London.**
 
• The apex institution of world cricket is the **International Cricket Council** (ICC) and its headquarters are now in **Dubai.**
 
• Earlier it was in Lords (England).
 
 
• The **ICC **was founded in **1909**.
 
 
 
• The **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** was formed in **1927**.
 
• Terminologies used in cricket are Toss, Run, Wicket, Bails, Crease, Pavilion, Maiden Over, Follow-on, Bowled, Stump Out, Run Out, L.B.W. Hit Wicket, Noball, Wide ball, Dead ball, Overthrow, Bye, Leg bye, Cover drive, Late cut, Hook, Glance, Stroke, Spot, Pull, Sixer, Followthrough, Googly, Cover, Gully, Long on, Silly point, Midwicket, Mid on, Forward short leg
 
• The** first slip** is a position behind the batsman.
 
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6cb7bb98dcc17f48addcf89dd90bf10f3d30a0f44a472e726676033410b738ee.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mid-wicket** is a position in** front of square on the leg side of the batsman. **
 
• **Mid-off** is the position** closest to the bowler on the off side.**
